claims: Laguna Beach is a coastal city in Southern California.
Laguna Beach has 7 miles of protected beaches.
Laguna Beach has a population of roughly 22,000.
Laguna Beach features hiking trails within 22,000 acres of protected wilderness.
Main Beach is located in the center of town.
Main Beach features a boardwalk.
Main Beach features tide pools.
Main Beach features volleyball courts.
Heisler Park offers walking trails with panoramic ocean views.
Crystal Cove State Park has an underwater park.
Crystal Cove State Park has snorkeling spots.
Victoria Beach has a pirate tower.
Aliso Beach Park is a spot for surfing.
Aliso Beach Park is a spot for skimboarding.
Pageant of the Masters is a show where art is re-created by real people.
Sawdust Art Festival is a summer festival highlighting local artists and craftsmen.
Festival of Arts is a summer arts event.
Art-A-Fair is a summer arts event.
Laguna Surf Lodge by SCP Hotels is located close to the beach.
Laguna Beach was the filming location for the 2000s MTV reality show Laguna Beach: The Real Orange County.
